items.title: Italy’s Z_One Fund secures over €35 million at first close to back AI and UrbanTech startups
items.summary: Z_One Fund, the Italian venture capital fund managed by Eureka! Venture has announced the first close at more than €35 million, with a total fundraising target of €60 million. The fund’s investor base includes some of Italy’s most prominent institutional investors. CDP Venture Capital SGR has committed capital through its newly launched Fondo Acceleratori 2. items.title: Finland’s Volare raises €7.1 million and opens 5,000-tonne insect protein factory
items.summary: Volare, a Finnish DeepTech company turning food-industry side streams into high-quality insect protein, has inaugurated its first industrial-scale facility called Volare 01 in Pori, Finland, and raised €7.1 million in fresh funding.
